post.caption: Tiffany's Pikachu came in a Poke Ball. In November 2023, Tiffany teamed up with artist Daniel Arsham on a Pokemon collection of nine pieces. Six Pokemon appear in it, including Pikachu and Jigglypuff. Most pendants are oxidized sterling silver with diamond accents, and the Pikachu pendant is 18 karat yellow gold in a Tiffany blue Poke Ball. Buyers had to sign up online and were picked in a draw. The gold Pikachu pendant cost 29,000 dollars in 2023.
